threat_event: Attacker who controls the owner's email sends a supplier a forged pickup authorization and diverts a bulk hydrogen peroxide load (an explosives precursor) to a truck the attacker arranged
threat_source: Criminal group (cargo theft by fictitious pickup); possibly someone seeking explosives precursors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Email is password-only and the password is reused; pickup authorizations are accepted by email with no call-back; no security plan
affected_asset_or_process: BP-02 shipment arrangement; SYS-01 email; supplier dock release
existing_controls: Supplier's clerk compares the driver with the name the owner sent; producers' end-use statements
treatment_plan: Email MFA and unique passphrase (2026-10-15); HSP-01 call-back verification and pickup-number rule in force 2026-10-05; standing hold-release instruction to each supplier (2026-10-31); monthly sign-in and forwarding-rule review

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects money: a spoofed or hijacked email gives a customer new bank details for paying the company, or gives the owner new bank details for a supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on email; bank-detail changes accepted by email; invoices carry bank details; one person pays and approves
affected_asset_or_process: BP-04 billing and payments; SYS-01; SYS-02; SYS-03
existing_controls: Bank text-message codes; accounting SaaS MFA
treatment_plan: Email MFA; call-back to a known number before any bank-detail change; invoice footer says bank details never change by email; bank payee-change alerts; payment-fraud training module

threat_event: Impostor posing as an existing customer, or a new fictitious customer, orders hydrogen peroxide for diversion using a lookalike domain (as on 2026-06-17)
threat_source: Criminal or person seeking explosives precursors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: New ship-to addresses and new customers accepted by email; no call-back; near miss not recorded
existing_controls: End-use statements on file for hydrogen peroxide customers
treatment_plan: HSP-01 know-your-customer steps: call-back on any new customer or ship-to; site visit or credit check for new hydrogen peroxide buyers; record and report suspicious orders

threat_event: DOT inspection or an incident finds the business offering bulk hydrogen peroxide with no security plan and with lapsed training
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written security plan since 2022; recurrent training lapsed 2025-06; no in-depth security training
treatment_plan: Adopt HSP-01 (2026-10-05); recurrent HMR course (2026-10-31); in-depth security training on HSP-01 (2026-11-30); annual plan review each September

threat_event: A wrong hazmat description goes on a BOL (copy error or an AI-drafted entry), so carriers and responders get the wrong class, packing group, or guide
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Descriptions typed or pasted per order; AI assistant drafted descriptions for new products; PG II shown for ferric chloride in 2026-05
existing_controls: Supplier's clerk reviews the BOL at loading
treatment_plan: Locked product description sheet checked against the Hazardous Materials Table; BOLs built only from it; no AI-drafted hazmat descriptions (P10); check against the HMT on each new product

threat_event: Emergency responders at a spill call the ERI number and the provider has no information on the product
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Product list updated only when the owner remembers; ferric chloride missing from 2025 to 2026-09-14
existing_controls: ERI contract; SDS emailed with each BOL
treatment_plan: Product list updated 2026-09-14; new-product checklist requires ERI confirmation before first shipment; annual reconciliation each September

threat_event: Email and files are lost (account takeover, mass deletion, or lockout), taking BOL copies, the workbook, and certificates with them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No backup outside the suite; one account holds everything
treatment_plan: Third-party backup of the suite or monthly encrypted export to an offline drive; quarterly restore test of one month's BOLs

threat_event: An attacker in the email account copies about 140 driver names with license numbers, triggering breach notice duties
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Driver data kept indefinitely in email; no MFA
treatment_plan: Stop storing full license numbers (supplier checks the license at the dock); delete driver data 90 days after delivery; purge 2022-2026 records

threat_event: Malware on the laptop, brought in by a family member's download or a browser add-on, steals saved passwords and session cookies
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Family use; daily administrator account; passwords saved in the browser
treatment_plan: End family use; standard account for daily work; password manager; clear browser-saved passwords

threat_event: Attacker or neighbor changes the home router's settings (default admin password) to redirect traffic or watch it
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default router admin password; unknown firmware status; shared household network
existing_controls: SaaS traffic uses TLS; host firewall on
treatment_plan: New router admin password; firmware check; separate work network

threat_event: Owner is suddenly unavailable or loses the phone while loads are on the road, so nobody can answer carriers, hold a release, or reach the accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; MFA codes on one phone; no coverage arrangement
existing_controls: ERI provider answers emergency calls 24 hours a day
treatment_plan: Supplier hold-release instruction; reciprocal coverage arrangement with another distributor; sealed recovery codes with the attorney; printed load list (P05)

threat_event: Customer prices, supplier confidential terms, or driver data typed into the AI assistant are kept or used by its vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model-improvement setting was on until 2026-09-18; no prompt rules
treatment_plan: P10 data rules: no driver data, customer prices, or supplier confidential terms in prompts; business plan with no-training terms at renewal

threat_event: Phone number hijacked by SIM swap, giving the attacker bank codes and account recovery
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No carrier account PIN; bank and email recovery by text message
treatment_plan: Carrier account PIN and port-out lock; authenticator app instead of text codes where offered

threat_event: Email suite outage longer than one business day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for orders and BOLs
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments (SOC 2 report, P09); phone fallback
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Phone the suppliers to confirm or hold pickups

threat_event: Hurricane cuts power and internet at the home office for several days
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from the phone; ERI provider is out of state
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Hold bulk releases when a hurricane warning is issued for the delivery route or the home office
